news.title: Santosh Fine Fab Ltd. Appoints Radha Shushil Kumar Sharma as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective April 13, 2026
news.body: Santosh Fine Fab Ltd. has appointed Ms. Radha Shushil Kumar Sharma (Membership No. A46047) as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from April 13, 2026, pursuant to Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013 and Regulation 6(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The appointment follows the resignation of the earlier company secretary Ms. Niti Jain on March 18, 2026. Ms. Radha S Sharma is an Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India having Membership No. A46047. She is also B.Com and having good amount of experience in corporate and allied laws.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. No experienced directors. 7 highly experienced directors. 3 independent directors (4 non-independent directors). Independent Non-Executive Director Radhaballabh Tibrewala was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2002. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.02 (vs ₹0.07 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.02 (down from ₹0.07 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹34.6m (down 20% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹59.0k (down 75% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.2% (down from 0.5% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 16% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 28% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
